name: Stalemate
source: In this game, you are a boy who already has a girlfriend. You also decided to help a mahou shoujo (magical girl) by being her mascot and battling monsters. And someday, you meet a girl that looks like your drawings.
translation: 在本作中，你扮演一名已经有女朋友的少年。你还决定成为一名魔法少女的吉祥物，帮助她与怪物战斗。某一天，你遇见了一名长得与自己画中人物一模一样的女孩。
